newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - MAY 30.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the May 31 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A string of commercial banks have been striving to give credits, at extremely unfavourable terms for the banks, to certain federal ministries. There must be a catch, says the paper.
- President Yeltsin is planning to sign a decree reestablishing a permanent guard of honour near the Kremlin.

- Ukrainian authorities have prepared a escape hatch in the form of a loose non-binding declaration in case President Boris Yeltsin decides against signing a comprehensive cooperation agreement with Kiev.
- The gold price on world markets is unlikely to increase and it may be time for Russia to start selling off its reserves.
